import ComputerMCPMacOS
import ComputerMCPPermissions
import ComputerMCPSandbox
import ComputerMCPTestSupport
import CryptoKit
import Darwin
import Foundation
import Testing

@testable import ComputerMCPConfiguration
@testable import ComputerMCPCore
@testable import ComputerMCPGateway
@testable import ComputerMCPPlugins

@Suite(.nativeIntegration, .serialized, .timeLimit(.minutes(8)))
struct ComputerUseSourceIntegrationTests {
  @Test func sourceConsumerContract() async throws {
    let environment = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment
    let source = URL(fileURLWithPath: try #require(environment["COMPUTER_MCP_CUA_PLUGIN"]))
    let package = try PluginPackage.load(at: source)
    let manifest = package.manifest
    try #require(manifest.id == "computer-use")
    try #require(Set(manifest.permissions?.map(\.id) ?? []) == [.screen, .desktopControl])
    try #require(manifest.permissions?.allSatisfy { $0.access == .allow } == true)
    try #require(manifest.sandbox == nil)
    let native = try #require(manifest.mcp.first)
    try #require(native.id == "native" && native.args == ["mcp"])
    try #require(native.executable?.dependency == "computer-use-client")
    try #require(native.requirements == nil && native.toolRequirements == nil)
    try #require(manifest.skills.first?.path == "skills")
    let before = try cuaDigest(source.appendingPathComponent(PluginManifest.filename))
    var cases: [String] = []

    try await withCUAHarness(source) { h in
      try #require(h.callCount == 0)
      let response = try await h.call("fixture_unknown")
      try cuaSuccess(response)
      try #require(h.callCount == 1)
      try h.requireDiscoveryBoundary()
    }
    cases += ["actual-source", "registration", "approval", "discovery", "cleanup"]

    for missingProvider in [false, true] {
      for permission in [Permission.screen, .desktopControl] {
        try await withCUAHarness(
          source, variant: .overrides, callerMissing: missingProvider ? nil : permission,
          providerMissing: missingProvider ? permission : nil
        ) { h in
          let response = try await h.call("fixture_act")
          let failure = try cuaFailure(response)
          try #require(failure["code"] == .string("permission.required"))
          try #require(h.callCount == 0)
          let requests = try h.gateway.permissionRuntime.service.view(owner: h.owner).requests
            .map(\.request).filter { request in
              guard case .permission(let content) = request.content else { return false }
              return content.requirement.permission == permission
            }
          try #require(requests.count == 1)
          let request = try #require(requests.first)
          if missingProvider {
            try #require(request.invocation.principal == .plugin(.package("computer-use")))
          } else {
            try #require(request.invocation.principal != .plugin(.package("computer-use")))
          }
          let service = h.gateway.permissionRuntime.service
          _ = try service.answerRequest(
            request.id, answer: .onlyThisTime, owner: h.owner,
            expectedRevision: service.view(owner: h.owner).revision)
          try #require(h.callCount == 0, "An answer must not dispatch a call")
          try await h.discover()
          let notRetried = try await h.call("fixture_act")
          try #require(try cuaFailure(notRetried)["code"] == .string("permission.required"))
          try #require(h.callCount == 0)
          try await h.discover()
          try cuaSuccess(try await h.call("fixture_act", retry: [request.id]))
          try #require(h.callCount == 1)
        }
      }
    }
    cases += ["dual-principal", "requests", "explicit-retry"]

    for provider in [false, true] {
      try await withCUAHarness(
        source, variant: .overrides, callerMissing: provider ? nil : .desktopControl,
        providerMissing: provider ? .desktopControl : nil, deny: true
      ) { h in
        let before = try h.gateway.permissionRuntime.service.view(owner: h.owner).requests.count
        let result = try await h.call("fixture_act")
        try #require(try cuaFailure(result)["code"] == .string("permission.denied"))
        try #require(h.callCount == 0)
        try #require(
          try h.gateway.permissionRuntime.service.view(owner: h.owner).requests.count == before)
      }
    }
    try await withCUAHarness(source, callerMissing: .desktopControl) { h in
      try #require(
        try cuaFailure(await h.call("fixture_unknown"))["code"] == .string("permission.required"))
      try #require(h.callCount == 0)
    }
    try await withCUAHarness(source, pluginUse: false) { h in
      let before = h.base.observations.members.count
      let failure = try cuaFailure(try await h.catalog())
      try #require(failure["code"] == .string("permission.required"))
      let requests = try h.gateway.permissionRuntime.service.view(owner: h.owner).requests
        .map(\.request)
      try #require(!requests.isEmpty)
      for request in requests {
        guard case .permission(let content) = request.content else {
          Issue.record("Missing Plugin use produced a different request kind")
          continue
        }
        try #require(content.requirement.permission == .plugin("computer-use"))
      }
      try #require(h.callCount == 0)
      try #require(h.base.observations.members.count == before && before == 0)
    }
    cases += ["deny", "plugin-use"]

    try await withCUAHarness(source, variant: .overrides, callerMissing: .desktopControl) { h in
      try cuaSuccess(try await h.call("fixture_observe"))
      let before = h.callCount
      for name in ["fixture_act", "fixture_unknown"] {
        try #require(try cuaFailure(await h.call(name))["code"] == .string("permission.required"))
        try #require(h.callCount == before)
      }
    }
    try await withCUAHarness(source, variant: .overrides) { h in
      try cuaSuccess(try await h.call("fixture_act"))
      try cuaSuccess(try await h.call("fixture_unknown"))
      try #require(h.callCount == 2)
      try await h.requireStaleDeclarationRefused()
    }
    try await withCUAHarness(source, variant: .defaults, callerMissing: .desktopControl) { h in
      try cuaSuccess(try await h.call("fixture_observe"))
      try #require(
        try cuaFailure(await h.call("fixture_unknown"))["code"] == .string("permission.required"))
      try #require(h.callCount == 1)
    }
    try requireAdditiveRequirements(source)
    cases += ["exact-overrides", "default-replacement", "additive-floor", "conservative", "stale"]

    try await withCUAHarness(source, exposed: ["fixture_observe"]) { h in
      let changes = h.gateway.toolChanges(context: .empty)
      let names = try await h.discover()
      try #require(names == ["fixture_observe"])

      // The admitted server catalog is available before the public reexport snapshot is published.
      let reexports = try await h.reexports(after: changes)
      try #require(reexports == ["cua-fixture.fixture_observe"])
      for hidden in ["fixture_act", "fixture_unknown"] {
        try #require(
          try cuaFailure(await h.call(hidden))["code"] == .string("mcp.tool_not_approved"))
        let direct = try await h.gateway.callToolForMCPAsync(
          name: "cua-fixture.\(hidden)", arguments: .object([:]), context: .empty)
        try #require(try cuaFailure(direct)["code"] == .string("gateway.tool_unknown"))
      }
      try #require(h.callCount == 0)
      try cuaSuccess(try await h.call("fixture_observe"))
      try #require(h.callCount == 1)
      let direct = try await h.gateway.callToolForMCPAsync(
        name: "cua-fixture.fixture_observe", arguments: .object([:]), context: .empty)
      try cuaSuccess(direct)
      try #require(h.callCount == 2)
    }
    cases += ["exposure"]

    for operation in ["disable", "provider-revoke", "caller-revoke"] {
      try await withCUAHarness(source) { h in
        let invocationStart = h.base.observations.ownerships.count
        try #require(invocationStart > 0, "Discovery must have its own provider execution")
        try cuaSuccess(try await h.call("fixture_unknown"))
        try #require(
          h.base.observations.ownerships.count > invocationStart,
          "The delegated invocation must have ownership separate from discovery")
        print("CUA revocation operation=\(operation) invocationOwnershipStart=\(invocationStart)")
        let before = h.callCount
        let service = h.gateway.permissionRuntime.service
        switch operation {
        case "disable":
          _ = try await h.store.setEnabled(
            false, for: "computer-use", expectedRevision: h.store.snapshot().revision)
        case "provider-revoke":
          let view = try service.view(owner: h.owner)
          let provider = try #require(
            view.providers.first { $0.identity == .package("computer-use") })
          _ = try service.revokeProvider(
            provider.identity, owner: h.owner, expectedProviderRevision: provider.revision,
            expectedRevision: view.revision)
        default:
          _ = try service.revokePermission(
            .plugin("computer-use"), profileID: h.consumerID, owner: h.owner,
            expectedRevision: service.view(owner: h.owner).revision)
        }
        try await h.gateway.permissionRuntime.coordinator.reconcile()
        let failure = try cuaFailure(try await h.catalog())
        try #require(failure["code"] != .string("permission.catalog_required"))
        if operation == "caller-revoke" {
          try #require(failure["code"] == .string("permission.denied"))
        } else if operation == "disable" {
          let state = try await h.store.snapshot()
          try #require(state.settings["computer-use"]?.enabled == false)
        } else {
          let view = try service.view(owner: h.owner)
          try #require(
            view.providers.first { $0.identity == .package("computer-use") }?.enabled == false)
        }
        _ = try cuaFailure(try await h.call("fixture_unknown"))
        try #require(h.callCount == before)
        // Caller revocation ends its delegation; projectless discovery is provider-owned.
        try await h.waitForRevokedProcesses(
          from: operation == "caller-revoke" ? invocationStart : 0, operation: operation)
      }
    }
    cases += ["disable", "provider-revoke", "caller-revoke", "joined-processes"]
    try await requireWorktreeContract(source)
    cases += ["worktree-source-floor", "worktree-inherited-gates", "worktree-removal-joins"]
    try #require(try cuaDigest(source.appendingPathComponent(PluginManifest.filename)) == before)
    let output = URL(fileURLWithPath: try #require(environment["COMPUTER_MCP_CUA_CASES"]))
    try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: [
      "kind": "deterministic", "tests_executed": 1,
      "run_id": try #require(environment["COMPUTER_MCP_CUA_RUN_ID"]), "cases": cases,
    ])
    .write(to: output, options: .atomic)
  }

  private func requireWorktreeContract(_ source: URL) async throws {
    try await withCUAHarness(source, worktree: .shipped) { h in
      let (request, requirement) = try h.requireRequest(
        await h.call("fixture_unknown"), permission: .project("fixture"), provider: true)
      try #require(requirement.value == .read)
      let service = h.gateway.permissionRuntime.service
      let revision = try service.view(owner: h.owner).revision
      #expect(throws: GatewayPermissionError.invalidBinding) {
        try service.answerRequest(
          request.id, answer: .onlyThisTime, owner: h.owner, expectedRevision: revision)
      }
      try #require(h.callCount == 0)
    }
    for permission in [Permission.screen, .desktopControl] {
      try await withCUAHarness(source, callerMissing: permission, worktree: .fixture) { h in
        _ = try h.requireRequest(
          await h.call("fixture_unknown"), permission: permission, provider: false)
        try #require(h.callCount == 0)
      }
      try await withCUAHarness(
        source, variant: .overrides, providerMissing: permission, worktree: .fixture
      ) { h in
        _ = try h.requireRequest(
          await h.call("fixture_act"), permission: permission, provider: true)
        try #require(h.callCount == 0)
      }
    }
    try await withCUAHarness(source, pluginUse: false, worktree: .fixture) { h in
      let before = h.base.observations.members.count
      _ = try h.requireRequest(
        await h.catalog(), permission: .plugin("computer-use"), provider: false)
      try #require(h.base.observations.members.count == before && h.callCount == 0)
    }
    try await withCUAHarness(source, worktree: .removal) { h in
      try await h.requireWorktreeRemoval()
    }
  }

  private func requireAdditiveRequirements(_ source: URL) throws {
    let original = try String(
      contentsOf: source.appendingPathComponent(PluginManifest.filename), encoding: .utf8)
    let manifest = try PluginManifest.parse(
      original.replacingOccurrences(
        of: "capabilities = ['tools']",
        with: "capabilities = ['tools']\n" + CUAVariant.defaults.fields))
    let reviewed = try PluginContributionRequirements(
      sourceDigest: PluginStore.manifestDigest(manifest), declarations: .init(manifest),
      componentID: "native")
    try #require(reviewed.requirements(for: "fixture_observe")?.permissions == [.screen])
    try #require(
      reviewed.requirements(for: "Fixture_observe")?.permissions.contains(.desktopControl) == true)
    let minimum = ToolRequirement(
      access: .projectWrite, permissions: [try .init(.unifiedLogs, .access)])
    let effective = reviewed.applying(to: minimum, tool: "fixture_observe")
    try #require(effective.access == .projectWrite)
    try #require(
      Set(effective.permissions) == [try .init(.screen, .access), try .init(.unifiedLogs, .access)])
  }
}

private enum CUAWorktreeMode {
  case shipped, fixture, removal
}

private struct CUAWorktree {
  let id: String
  let path: URL
  let branch: String

  static func create(
    _ name: String, using lifecycle: GatewayStandaloneGenerations, session: GatewayControlSession
  ) async throws -> Self {
    let result = try await lifecycle.callToolForMCPAsync(
      name: "git.worktree_add", arguments: .object(["name": .string(name)]),
      context: .init(session: session))
    let receipt = try cuaResult(result)
    print("CUA worktree create receipt: \(result)")
    return try Self(
      id: #require(receipt["project_id"]?.stringValue),
      path: URL(fileURLWithPath: #require(receipt["path"]?.stringValue)),
      branch: #require(receipt["branch"]?.stringValue))
  }

  func remove(
    using lifecycle: GatewayStandaloneGenerations, session: GatewayControlSession
  ) async throws -> [String: JSONValue] {
    let result = try await lifecycle.callToolForMCPAsync(
      name: "git.worktree_remove", arguments: .object(["project_id": .string(id)]),
      context: .init(session: session))
    let receipt = try cuaResult(result)
    print("CUA worktree remove receipt: \(result)")
    try #require(receipt["project_id"] == .string(id))
    try #require(receipt["branch"] == .string("refs/heads/" + branch))
    try #require(receipt["terminationWarnings"] == .array([]))
    try #require(!FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: path.path))
    return receipt
  }
}

private enum CUAVariant {
  case overrides, defaults

  var fields: String {
    let overrides =
      "tool_requirements = { fixture_observe = { project = 'none', permissions = ['screen'] }, fixture_act = { project = 'none', permissions = ['screen', 'desktop-control'] } }"
    return self == .defaults
      ? "requirements = { project = 'none', permissions = ['screen', 'desktop-control'] }\n"
        + overrides
      : overrides
  }
}

private func cuaDigest(_ url: URL) throws -> String {
  SHA256.hash(data: try Data(contentsOf: url)).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
}

private func cuaSuccess(_ result: JSONValue) throws {
  try #require(result.objectValue?["isError"] != .bool(true), "\(result)")
  // Generic forwarding wraps the native MCP result inside the host result.
  let nested = result.objectValue?["structuredContent"]?.objectValue?["result"]
  try #require(nested?.objectValue?["isError"] != .bool(true), "\(result)")
}

private func cuaFailure(_ result: JSONValue) throws -> [String: JSONValue] {
  try #require(result.objectValue?["isError"] == .bool(true), "\(result)")
  return try #require(result.objectValue?["structuredContent"]?.objectValue?["error"]?.objectValue)
}

private func cuaResult(_ result: JSONValue) throws -> [String: JSONValue] {
  try cuaSuccess(result)
  return try #require(result.objectValue?["structuredContent"]?.objectValue?["result"]?.objectValue)
}

private func withCUAHarness(
  _ source: URL, variant: CUAVariant? = nil, callerMissing: Permission? = nil,
  providerMissing: Permission? = nil, deny: Bool = false, pluginUse: Bool = true,
  exposed: [String] = ["fixture_observe", "fixture_act", "fixture_unknown"],
  worktree: CUAWorktreeMode? = nil,
  operation: (CUAHarness) async throws -> Void
) async throws {
  let harness = try await CUAHarness.make(
    source, variant: variant, callerMissing: callerMissing, providerMissing: providerMissing,
    deny: deny, pluginUse: pluginUse, exposed: exposed, worktree: worktree)
  do {
    if pluginUse { try await harness.discover() }
    try await operation(harness)
  } catch {
    do { try await harness.close() } catch { Issue.record("CUA fixture cleanup failed: \(error)") }
    throw error
  }
  try await harness.close()
}

private final class CUAHarness: @unchecked Sendable {
  let base: FixedHostFixture
  let gateway: GatewayRuntime
  let owner: GatewayPermissionOwner
  let package: PluginPackage
  let store: PluginStore
  let consumerID: GatewayProfileID
  let home: URL
  let outside: URL
  let variant: CUAVariant?
  let lifecycle: GatewayStandaloneGenerations?
  let worktrees: [CUAWorktree]

  init(
    base: FixedHostFixture, gateway: GatewayRuntime, owner: GatewayPermissionOwner,
    package: PluginPackage, store: PluginStore, consumerID: GatewayProfileID,
    home: URL, outside: URL, variant: CUAVariant?, lifecycle: GatewayStandaloneGenerations?,
    worktrees: [CUAWorktree]
  ) {
    self.base = base
    self.gateway = gateway
    self.owner = owner
    self.package = package
    self.store = store
    self.consumerID = consumerID
    self.home = home
    self.outside = outside
    self.variant = variant
    self.lifecycle = lifecycle
    self.worktrees = worktrees
  }

  static func make(
    _ source: URL, variant: CUAVariant?, callerMissing: Permission?, providerMissing: Permission?,
    deny: Bool, pluginUse: Bool, exposed: [String], worktree: CUAWorktreeMode?
  ) async throws -> CUAHarness {
    let base = try FixedHostFixture(fullAccess: false, lifecycle: worktree != nil)
    let lifecycle = worktree.map { _ in GatewayStandaloneGenerations(base.runtime) }
    var worktrees: [CUAWorktree] = []
    print("CUA fixture root: \(base.root.path)")
    print(
      "CUA scenario variant=\(String(describing: variant)) callerMissing=\(String(describing: callerMissing)) "
        + "providerMissing=\(String(describing: providerMissing)) deny=\(deny) pluginUse=\(pluginUse) "
        + "worktree=\(String(describing: worktree))"
    )
    var pending: GatewayRuntime?
    do {
      if let lifecycle {
        try await base.initializeRepository()
        for name in worktree == .removal ? ["cua-target", "cua-sibling"] : ["cua-target"] {
          worktrees.append(
            try await CUAWorktree.create(name, using: lifecycle, session: base.session))
        }
      }
      let fixtureProjectGrant = worktree != nil && worktree != .shipped
      let packageRoot: URL
      if variant != nil || fixtureProjectGrant {
        packageRoot = base.root.appendingPathComponent("synthetic-package")
        try FileManager.default.copyItem(at: source, to: packageRoot)
        let file = packageRoot.appendingPathComponent(PluginManifest.filename)
        var text = try String(contentsOf: file, encoding: .utf8)
        if let variant {
          let marker = "capabilities = ['tools']"
          try #require(text.components(separatedBy: marker).count == 2)
          text = text.replacingOccurrences(of: marker, with: marker + "\n" + variant.fields)
        }
        if fixtureProjectGrant {
          let marker = "[[dependencies]]"
          try #require(text.components(separatedBy: marker).count == 2)
          text = text.replacingOccurrences(
            of: marker,
            with: """
              [[permissions]]
              id = 'project'
              access = 'read'
              purpose = 'Read the disposable source project in the Host worktree fixture.'

              \(marker)
              """)
        }
        try text.write(to: file, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
      } else {
        packageRoot = source
      }
      let package = try PluginPackage.load(at: packageRoot)
      let outside = base.root.appendingPathComponent("denied-write")
      try Data("sentinel".utf8).write(to: outside)
      let binary = base.root.appendingPathComponent("native-peer")
      let compiler = Process()
      compiler.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: "/usr/bin/cc")
      compiler.arguments = [
        "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
        "-DPEER_OUTSIDE=\"\(outside.path)\"",
        source.appendingPathComponent("tests/fixtures/native_mcp.c").path, "-o", binary.path,
      ]
      try compiler.run()
      compiler.waitUntilExit()
      try #require(compiler.terminationStatus == 0)
      let store = PluginStore(database: base.database, platform: base.platform)
      let runtime = base.runtime.permissionRuntime
      let baselinePermissions = try runtime.store.readWithDatabase { _, ledger in
        ledger.permissions(for: .plugin(.package("computer-use")))
      }
      try #require(baselinePermissions.state(for: .screen) == .notGranted)
      try #require(baselinePermissions.state(for: .desktopControl) == .notGranted)
      let state = try await store.registerDevelopment(
        at: package.root, expectedRevision: store.snapshot().revision)
      try #require(state.settings["computer-use"]?.enabled == false)
      let disabled = try PluginResolver.resolve(
        package: package, source: .init(kind: .development, root: package.root),
        settings: try #require(state.settings["computer-use"]),
        hostVersion: PluginVersion(ComputerMCPCLI.version), architecture: PluginHost.architecture)
      try #require(disabled.mcpServers.isEmpty && disabled.skillRoots.isEmpty)
      let review = try GatewayProviderReview(
        package: package, configuration: base.database.configurationState())
      #expect(throws: (any Error).self) {
        try runtime.service.authorizeProviderExecution(
          review: review, registrationID: "cua-fixture", caller: nil, retryIDs: [])
      }
      try runtime.store.readWithDatabase { _, ledger in
        let registeredPermissions = ledger.permissions(for: .plugin(.package("computer-use")))
        try #require(registeredPermissions.entries == baselinePermissions.entries)
        try #require(registeredPermissions.state(for: .screen) == .notGranted)
        try #require(registeredPermissions.state(for: .desktopControl) == .notGranted)
      }
      var settings = try #require(state.settings["computer-use"])
      settings.dependencyExecutables = ["computer-use-client": binary.path]
      settings.mcp["native"] = .init(
        registrationID: "cua-fixture", exposure: .reexport, prefix: "cua-fixture",
        allowedTools: exposed,
        toolRisks: Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: exposed.map { ($0, CapabilityRisk.readOnly) }))
      _ = try await store.setSettings(
        settings, for: "computer-use", expectedRevision: store.snapshot().revision)
      func permissions(missing: Permission?, use: Bool, projectRead: Bool) -> Permissions {
        var values: [Permission: PermissionState] = [
          .screen: .granted(.access), .desktopControl: .granted(.access),
        ]
        if let missing {
          if deny {
            values[missing] = .denied
          } else {
            values.removeValue(forKey: missing)
          }
        }
        if use { values[.plugin("computer-use")] = .granted(.use) }
        if projectRead { values[.project("fixture")] = .granted(.read) }
        return fixturePermissions(values)
      }
      try fixtureApprovePlugin(
        package, database: base.database, runtime: runtime,
        permissions: permissions(
          missing: providerMissing, use: false, projectRead: fixtureProjectGrant))
      let enabledState = try await store.snapshot()
      let enabled = try #require(enabledState.settings["computer-use"])
      try #require(enabled.enabled && enabled.mcp["native"]?.allowedTools == exposed)
      let plugin = try PluginResolver.resolve(
        package: package, source: .init(kind: .development, root: package.root), settings: enabled,
        dependencyExecutables: ["computer-use-client": binary],
        hostVersion: PluginVersion(ComputerMCPCLI.version), architecture: PluginHost.architecture)
      try #require(plugin.diagnostics.isEmpty && plugin.mcpServers.count == 1)
      let consumerID = try #require(GatewayProfileID(rawValue: "cua-consumer"))
      let lifecycleProfile = try #require(
        base.database.profiles().first { $0.id == base.configuration.runtime.profileID })
      try #require(consumerID != .localAdmin && consumerID != lifecycleProfile.id)
      let consumer = ProfileGrant(
        id: consumerID,
        permissions: permissions(
          missing: callerMissing, use: pluginUse, projectRead: worktree != nil),
        allowedCallers: [.localMCP])
      try base.database.saveProfile(consumer)
      let gateway = try GatewayRuntime(
        configuration: .init(
          runtime: .init(caller: .localMCP, profileID: consumerID),
          profiles: base.configuration.profiles + [.init(grant: consumer)]),
        context: .init(
          caller: .localMCP, profileID: consumerID, projectID: worktrees.first?.id,
          trustedPrincipalID: "cua-consumer"),
        database: base.database,
        registeredProjects: worktree == nil ? [] : base.database.projects(),
        platform: base.platform, plugins: [plugin],
        bundledPlugins: .init(packages: [], issues: []))
      pending = gateway
      _ = try gateway.makeControlSession()
      if worktree == nil { try #require(gateway.unambiguousProjectID == nil) }
      try #require(
        base.database.profiles().first { $0.id == lifecycleProfile.id } == lifecycleProfile)
      let owner = try GatewayPermissionOwner(
        context: .init(caller: .localApp, profileID: .localAdmin, trustedPrincipalID: "cua-owner"),
        validate: {})
      let approval = try #require(
        runtime.service.view(owner: owner).providers.first {
          $0.identity == .package("computer-use")
        })
      try #require(approval.enabled && approval.fullAccessConsent == nil)
      let sourceDigest = try PluginStore.manifestDigest(package.manifest)
      let declarationDigest = try PluginPermissionDeclarations(package.manifest).digest()
      let origin = try #require(plugin.origins[.init(kind: .mcp, id: "cua-fixture")])
      try #require(origin.source.root == package.root)
      try #require(origin.reviewedRequirements?.sourceDigest == sourceDigest)
      try #require(approval.sourceDigest == sourceDigest)
      try #require(approval.declarationDigest == declarationDigest)
      let selectedID = try #require(enabledState.selectedInstallations["computer-use"])
      let installation = try #require(enabledState.installations.first { $0.id == selectedID })
      try #require(
        installation.source.root == package.root && installation.manifestDigest == sourceDigest)
      try runtime.store.readWithDatabase { _, ledger in
        try #require(approval.epoch == ledger.authorizationEpochID)
      }
      print("CUA binding setup verified source=\(sourceDigest) declarations=\(declarationDigest)")
      let container = try base.database.prepareProviderContainer(.package("computer-use"))
      let sandbox = try container.sandbox
      return CUAHarness(
        base: base, gateway: gateway, owner: owner, package: package, store: store,
        consumerID: consumerID, home: URL(fileURLWithPath: sandbox.home.value),
        outside: outside, variant: variant, lifecycle: lifecycle, worktrees: worktrees)
    } catch {
      await pending?.shutdown()
      if let lifecycle {
        for worktree in worktrees.reversed() {
          do { _ = try await worktree.remove(using: lifecycle, session: base.session) } catch {
            Issue.record("CUA worktree cleanup failed: \(error)")
          }
        }
        await lifecycle.shutdown()
      } else {
        await base.runtime.shutdown()
      }
      base.session.end()
      for ownership in base.observations.ownerships {
        try #require(try await ownership.members().isEmpty)
      }
      try FileManager.default.removeItem(at: base.root)
      throw error
    }
  }

  var callCount: Int {
    let path = home.appendingPathComponent("cua-peer-calls.log")
    return (try? String(contentsOf: path, encoding: .utf8).split(separator: "\n").count) ?? 0
  }

  func catalog(projectID: String? = nil) async throws -> JSONValue {
    let before = try base.database.configurationState()
    var arguments: [String: JSONValue] = ["server": .string("cua-fixture")]
    if let projectID { arguments["project_id"] = .string(projectID) }
    let result = try await gateway.callToolForMCPAsync(
      name: "mcp.tools.list", arguments: .object(arguments), context: .empty)
    if result.objectValue?["isError"] == .bool(true) {
      let after = try base.database.configurationState()
      let current = try PluginPackage.load(at: package.root)
      let error = result.objectValue?["structuredContent"]?.objectValue?["error"]
      let diagnostic: [String: Any] = [
        "stage": "catalog", "code": error?.objectValue?["code"]?.stringValue ?? "missing",
        "configuration_unchanged": before == after,
        "profiles_unchanged": before.profiles == after.profiles,
        "profile_source_unchanged": before.profileSource == after.profileSource,
        "plugins_unchanged": before.plugins == after.plugins,
        "projects_unchanged": before.projects == after.projects,
        "aliases_unchanged": before.projectAliases == after.projectAliases,
        "derived_projects_unchanged": before.derivedProjects == after.derivedProjects,
        "manifest_unchanged": try PluginStore.manifestDigest(current.manifest)
          == PluginStore.manifestDigest(package.manifest),
        "tool_calls": callCount,
      ]
      let bytes = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: diagnostic, options: [.sortedKeys])
      print("CUA binding diagnostic: " + String(decoding: bytes, as: UTF8.self))
    }
    return result
  }

  @discardableResult
  func discover(projectID: String? = nil) async throws -> [String] {
    let before = callCount
    let result = try await catalog(projectID: projectID)
    try cuaSuccess(result)
    let tools = try #require(
      result.objectValue?["structuredContent"]?.objectValue?["result"]?.arrayValue)
    try #require(!tools.isEmpty)
    try #require(callCount == before, "Catalog discovery must not invoke a tool")
    return try tools.map { try #require($0.objectValue?["name"]?.stringValue) }
  }

  func reexports(after changes: AsyncStream<Void>) async throws -> [String] {
    @Sendable func names() async throws -> [String] {
      try await gateway.listToolsAsync(context: .empty).map(\.name)
        .filter { $0.hasPrefix("cua-fixture.") }
    }
    return try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: [String].self) { group in
      group.addTask {
        let initial = try await names()
        if !initial.isEmpty { return initial }
        for await _ in changes {
          let updated = try await names()
          if !updated.isEmpty { return updated }
        }
        return try await names()
      }
      group.addTask {
        try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(5))
        return try await names()
      }
      defer { group.cancelAll() }
      return try #require(await group.next())
    }
  }

  func call(_ name: String, retry: [UUID] = [], projectID: String? = nil) async throws -> JSONValue
  {
    var arguments: [String: JSONValue] = [
      "server": .string("cua-fixture"), "tool": .string(name), "arguments": .object([:]),
    ]
    if !retry.isEmpty {
      arguments["_permission_request_ids"] = .array(retry.map { .string($0.uuidString) })
    }
    if let projectID = projectID ?? worktrees.first?.id {
      arguments["project_id"] = .string(projectID)
    }
    return try await gateway.callToolForMCPAsync(
      name: "mcp.tools.call", arguments: .object(arguments), context: .empty)
  }

  func requireRequest(_ response: JSONValue, permission: Permission, provider: Bool) throws
    -> (PermissionRequest, PermissionRequirement)
  {
    let failure = try cuaFailure(response)
    try #require(failure["code"] == .string("permission.required"), "\(response)")
    try #require(failure["call_dispatched"] == .bool(false))
    let ids = try #require(failure["request_ids"]?.arrayValue)
    let requests = try gateway.permissionRuntime.service.view(owner: owner).requests
      .map(\.request).filter { ids.contains(.string($0.id.uuidString)) }
    try #require(requests.count == 1)
    let request = try #require(requests.first)
    let providerPrincipal = Principal.plugin(.package("computer-use"))
    try #require((request.invocation.principal == providerPrincipal) == provider)
    if permission != .plugin("computer-use") {
      try #require(request.invocation.projectID == worktrees.first?.id)
    }
    guard case .permission(let content) = request.content else {
      throw GatewayPermissionError.invalidBinding
    }
    try #require(content.requirement.permission == permission)
    return (request, content.requirement)
  }

  func requireWorktreeRemoval() async throws {
    let lifecycle = try #require(lifecycle)
    let target = try #require(worktrees.first)
    let sibling = try #require(worktrees.last)
    try #require(target.id != sibling.id && target.path != sibling.path)
    let consumer = try #require(base.database.profiles().first { $0.id == consumerID })
    let provider = try gateway.permissionRuntime.store.readWithDatabase { _, ledger in
      ledger.permissions(for: .plugin(.package("computer-use")))
    }
    for permissions in [consumer.permissions, provider] {
      try #require(permissions.state(for: .project("fixture")) == .granted(.read))
      try #require(permissions.state(for: .project(target.id)) == .notGranted)
      try #require(permissions.state(for: .project(sibling.id)) == .notGranted)
    }
    let oid = try await base.ownerGit(["rev-parse", "HEAD"]).trimmingCharacters(
      in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
    let foreign = try base.database.prepareProviderContainer(.package("foreign-provider")).sandbox
    let sentinel = URL(fileURLWithPath: foreign.state.value).appendingPathComponent("sentinel")
    try Data("foreign".utf8).write(to: sentinel)

    let targetProcess = try await invokeInWorktree(target)
    try await discover(projectID: sibling.id)
    let siblingProcess = try await invokeInWorktree(sibling)
    try #require(callCount == 2)
    let targetMembers = try await targetProcess.members()
    let siblingMembers = try await siblingProcess.members()
    try #require(!targetMembers.isEmpty && !siblingMembers.isEmpty)
    try #require(Set(targetMembers).isDisjoint(with: siblingMembers))

    let receipt = try await target.remove(using: lifecycle, session: base.session)
    try #require(receipt["oid"] == .string(oid))
    try #require(try await targetProcess.members().isEmpty)
    try #require(try Set(await siblingProcess.members()) == Set(siblingMembers))
    try #require(try base.database.project(id: target.id) == nil)
    try #require(try base.database.project(id: sibling.id)?.rootPath == sibling.path.path)
    for root in [base.project, sibling.path] {
      try #require(
        try String(contentsOf: root.appendingPathComponent("value.txt"), encoding: .utf8)
          == "original")
    }
    try #require(try String(contentsOf: sentinel, encoding: .utf8) == "foreign")
    try #require(callCount == 2, "Removal must not invoke a downstream tool")
  }

  private func invokeInWorktree(_ worktree: CUAWorktree) async throws -> any ExecutionOwnership {
    let before = base.observations.ownerships.count
    let result = try cuaResult(await call("fixture_unknown", projectID: worktree.id))
    let peer = try #require(result["structuredContent"]?.objectValue)
    let cwd = try #require(peer["cwd"]?.stringValue)
    let pid = try #require(peer["pid"]?.intValue)
    try #require(peer["tool"] == .string("fixture_unknown"))
    try #require(URL(fileURLWithPath: cwd).resolvingSymlinksInPath().path == worktree.path.path)
    for ownership in base.observations.ownerships.dropFirst(before) {
      let state = try ownership.recoveryState()
      guard state.root.processID == pid else { continue }
      try #require(state.sandboxed)
      print("CUA worktree peer project=\(worktree.id) pid=\(pid) cwd=\(cwd)")
      return ownership
    }
    Issue.record("No Host-owned execution matched the scoped peer PID \(pid)")
    throw GatewayPermissionError.invalidBinding
  }

  func requireDiscoveryBoundary() throws {
    let rows = try String(
      contentsOf: home.appendingPathComponent("cua-peer-discovery.log"), encoding: .utf8
    ).split(separator: "\n")
    try #require(!rows.isEmpty)
    func canonicalPath(_ url: URL) -> String {
      url.resolvingSymlinksInPath().standardizedFileURL.path
    }
    let executionRoot = canonicalPath(base.database.permissionExecutionRoot)
    let packageRoot = canonicalPath(package.root)
    let projectRoot = canonicalPath(base.project)
    for row in rows {
      let observed = canonicalPath(URL(fileURLWithPath: String(row)))
      try #require(observed != packageRoot && observed != projectRoot)
      try #require(observed.hasPrefix(executionRoot + "/"))
    }
    let settings = try base.database.prepareProviderContainer(.package("computer-use")).sandbox
    for path in [settings.home.value, settings.cache.value, settings.state.value] {
      try #require(FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: path + "/cua-peer-marker"))
    }
    try #require(try String(contentsOf: outside, encoding: .utf8) == "sentinel")
  }

  func requireStaleDeclarationRefused() async throws {
    try #require(variant != nil)
    let file = package.root.appendingPathComponent(PluginManifest.filename)
    let old = try String(contentsOf: file, encoding: .utf8)
    let before = callCount
    let review = try GatewayProviderReview(
      package: package, configuration: base.database.configurationState())
    try old.replacingOccurrences(
      of: "permissions = ['screen']", with: "permissions = ['desktop-control']"
    ).write(to: file, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
    _ = try await store.registerDevelopment(
      at: package.root, expectedRevision: store.snapshot().revision)
    #expect(throws: (any Error).self) {
      try gateway.permissionRuntime.service.authorizeProviderExecution(
        review: review, registrationID: "cua-fixture", caller: nil, retryIDs: [])
    }
    let failure = try cuaFailure(try await catalog())
    try #require(failure["code"] != .string("permission.catalog_required"))
    _ = try cuaFailure(try await call("fixture_observe"))
    try #require(callCount == before)
  }

  func waitForRevokedProcesses(from firstOwnership: Int, operation: String) async throws {
    let deadline = ContinuousClock.now.advanced(by: .seconds(2))
    let targets = Array(base.observations.ownerships.enumerated().dropFirst(firstOwnership))
    try #require(!targets.isEmpty)
    try await gateway.permissionRuntime.coordinator.reconcile(until: deadline)
    for (index, ownership) in targets {
      let rootPID = try ownership.recoveryState().root.processID
      do {
        _ = try await ownership.wait(until: deadline)
        try #require(try await ownership.members().isEmpty)
      } catch {
        let remaining = try? await ownership.members()
        print(
          "CUA revocation join operation=\(operation) ownership=\(index) rootPID=\(rootPID) "
            + "remaining=\(String(describing: remaining)) error=\(error)")
        throw error
      }
    }
  }

  func requireJoined() async throws {
    for ownership in base.observations.ownerships {
      try #require(try await ownership.members().isEmpty)
    }
  }

  func close() async throws {
    if let lifecycle {
      for worktree in worktrees.reversed() {
        do {
          if try base.database.project(id: worktree.id) != nil {
            _ = try await worktree.remove(using: lifecycle, session: base.session)
          }
        } catch {
          Issue.record("CUA worktree cleanup failed: \(error)")
        }
      }
      await gateway.shutdown()
      await lifecycle.shutdown()
    } else {
      await gateway.shutdown()
      await base.runtime.shutdown()
    }
    try await base.requireNoScratch()
    base.session.end()
    try await requireJoined()
    try FileManager.default.removeItem(at: base.root)
    try #require(!FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: base.root.path))
  }
}
